what.value: Evaluates open-research training (ORP) as a learning system, closing the gap between what the ORP evaluation established and what UKRN-S's design commitments need as evidence.
what.quote: UKRN-S is a Community Interest Company that has just inherited the wind-down of the ORP. It faces design decisions on a calendar (Elle's planning meeting is in May 2026) before any of the four sorries are closed by additional empirical work. The mission's gap is the gap between *what ORP evaluation could establish on its own evidence* and *what UKRN-S's commitments need to be evidence-grounded*.

area.quote: Evaluating open-research training as a learning system: closing the gap between what the ORP evaluation could establish on its own evidence and what UKRN-S's design commitments need to be evidence-grounded.
